instruction: Boundary Condition Completion. For this task, launch the OpenStudio application from `/usr/local/bin/OpenStudioApp` and open `init.osm`. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. The starting model already contains the repaired two-room OSM surface metadata and does not contain an embedded FloorspaceJS-editable floorplan.json; use the existing OSM surfaces and do not attempt to recreate or edit this geometry in FloorspaceJS. Review the NorthRoom and SouthRoom spaces, story and zone assignments, zone HVAC equipment lists, paired internal boundary, and target geometry, then save `/home/user/Desktop/result.osm`. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 2 spaces and 2 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: NorthRoom and SouthRoom. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. The model enclosure must contain 12 OS:Surface objects, split into 2 floor surfaces, 2 roof/ceiling surfaces and 8 wall surfaces. The outside-boundary counts must be exactly 2 Ground, 8 Outdoors and 2 Surface: the two floors are Ground; the two roofs and six exterior walls are Outdoors; and the shared partition pair is NorthRoom South Wall <-> SouthRoom North Wall. Both members of that pair must use the Surface outside boundary condition and each member's Outside Boundary Condition Object must reference the other member. Do not add any windows or other subsurfaces. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 2 zone HVAC equipment lists and 0 dual-setpoint thermostats. The geometry should have an overall surface-geometry bounding box spanning 10.00 m in X, 8.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 80.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 115.20 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
